title: Ezra Bridger
subtitle: Rebel
description: Found on the streets of Lothal stealing from the Empire to get by, young Ezra Bridger was trained in the ways of the Force by Kanan Jarrus of the Ghost Squadron. Wary of strangers, it took a while for Ezra to fit in, but once he did, the crew became his family. Though Maul tried to convert him to the dark side, Ezra stayed true to his teachings.
